newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux says dissolves FHP Motors JV.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux says dissolves FHP Motors JV.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker AB Electrolux on Thursday said it was dissolving an electric motor joint venture, FHP Motors GmbH, owned in conjunction with TEMIC Telefunken microelectronic GmbH.
It said the joint venture, making and selling fractional horsepower electric motors, was originally formed with AEG AG, with production in Germany, Italy, Sweden and Hungary.
AEG's share of the company has since been taken over by TEMIC Telefunken.
Electrolux said both companies had agreed to dissolve the joint venture with effect from September 1 this year.
"(This) is in line with the group's efforts to concentrate its activities to core business areas such as household appliances," Electrolux said in a statement.
